data.taxBenefit: Eligible for Beckham Law reduced tax regime offering a 24% flat tax rate on income up to EUR 600,000.
requirements: Proof of minimum monthly income of EUR 2,646 (200% of Spanish minimum wage).
Proof of work contract or freelancing with non-Spanish companies for at least 3 months.
Higher education degree or minimum 3 years of professional work experience.
Clean criminal record and valid private health insurance in Spain.

data.taxBenefit: Access to special tax frameworks for qualified scientific, artistic, or technical activities
requirements: Proof of monthly income equal to or exceeding 4x Portuguese national minimum wage (EUR 3,280)
Proof of remote employment contract or self-employment for non-Portuguese entities
Proof of accommodation in Portugal for at least one year
Clean criminal record certificate

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is exempt from Japanese personal income tax during the 6-month stay.
requirements: Annual income of JPY 10 million or more (approx. 833,333 JPY/month)
Citizen of an eligible country with a visa waiver and tax treaty agreement with Japan
Private health insurance with coverage for medical care and repatriation during the stay
Must work remotely for a company or clients located outside of Japan

data.taxBenefit: Tax exempt on foreign income for stays up to 183 days within a 12-month period
requirements: Proof of remote work capability using location-independent telecommunications technology
Active employment, business ownership, or freelance contracts outside Estonia
Minimum gross monthly income of EUR 4,500 for the 6 months prior to application
Valid health insurance coverage for the entire duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: 100% exemption from personal income tax in Croatia on remote work income from foreign sources
requirements: Must work remotely for a company registered outside Croatia or own a foreign company
Proof of minimum monthly income or sufficient funds in bank account
Valid health insurance covering the territory of Croatia for the duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is exempt from tax under specific conditions, though tax residence applies if staying over 182 days.
requirements: Minimum annual income of USD 24,000 (USD 2,000 per month)
Proof of employment or freelance contracts in digital domain
Passport valid for at least 14 months
Medical insurance covering Malaysia

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax exemption on salary income exceeding TWD 3 million for up to 5 years
requirements: Minimum monthly salary of TWD 160,000 in a relevant industry, or meeting specific field qualification criteria
Professional expertise in one of ten recognized fields (e.g., Science, Technology, Economy, Education, Culture, Finance)
Valid passport with at least six months of validity remaining

data.stayDuration: 5 Years (Up to 180 days per entry, extendable by 180 days)
data.taxBenefit: Foreign income not remitted into Thailand in the same tax year is generally tax-exempt under territorial tax rules.
requirements: Proof of financial funds or bank balance of at least 500,000 THB
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or enrollment in eligible soft power activities
Passport valid for at least 6 months from arrival date

data.taxBenefit: 50% tax reduction on Greek-sourced income for up to 7 years when transferring tax residence
requirements: Proof of monthly foreign income of at least EUR 3,500 net
Proof of employment or business registered outside of Greece
Clean criminal record from country of residence
Comprehensive health insurance coverage in Greece

data.taxBenefit: Nomads staying under 183 days pay no local tax; those staying over 183 days can qualify for the non-domiciled tax regime with 0% tax on dividends and interest.
requirements: Proof of net monthly income of at least EUR 3,500 from non-Cypriot sources
Remote work contract or proof of ownership of a company registered abroad
Valid comprehensive health insurance covering Cyprus
Clean criminal record certificate and proof of accommodation

data.taxBenefit: No local income tax obligations in Iceland if staying under 183 days
requirements: Must be a non-EU/EEA/EFTA passport holder
Proof of remote employment or self-employment outside Iceland
Minimum monthly income of 1,000,000 ISK (approx. $7,000 USD)
Valid health insurance coverage for Iceland

data.processingTime: Immediate (No visa required prior to arrival)
data.taxBenefit: Svalbard operates its own low-tax regime (flat ~15.9% total income tax and social security) separate from mainland Norway.
requirements: Demonstrated ability to be financially self-sufficient and afford accommodation in Longyearbyen
Valid passport and proper Schengen visa/transit authorization to travel through mainland Norway
Comprehensive private health insurance valid for the duration of stay in Svalbard

data.taxBenefit: Eligible for the flat-rate tax scheme (Paušální daň) combining income tax, social security, and health insurance into one low monthly payment.
requirements: Valid Czech trade license (Živnostenský list) registered in an official trade register
Proof of minimum funds in a bank account (at least 156,500 CZK)
Proof of accommodation in the Czech Republic for at least 1 year
Clean criminal record certificate and comprehensive health insurance coverage

data.taxBenefit: Qualifying digital nomads may benefit from the Inpatriates tax regime offering significant income tax reductions.
requirements: Minimum annual income of EUR 28,000 earned from remote work
At least 6 months of work experience as a remote worker or digital nomad
Comprehensive health insurance valid in Italy
Proof of accommodation in Italy and clean criminal record

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from income tax, social security, and health contributions on foreign earnings
requirements: Proof of foreign monthly income of at least 3 times the Romanian average gross monthly salary (~EUR 3,700/month) for the previous 6 months
Proof of employment or business ownership outside Romania for at least 3 years prior to application
Valid travel health insurance covering minimum EUR 30,000 for the entire visa duration
Clean criminal record certificate and proof of accommodation in Romania

data.taxBenefit: No personal income tax or capital gains tax applies to certificate holders in Bermuda.
requirements: Proof of remote employment or business ownership outside Bermuda
Continuous source of annual income or sufficient financial means
Valid health insurance coverage and clean criminal record

data.taxBenefit: No local income tax, capital gains tax, or wealth tax on foreign earnings
requirements: Proof of remote employment, self-employment, or virtual student enrollment
Valid passport
Valid health insurance coverage for The Bahamas

data.visaName: Digital Nomad Visa (Estancia de Trabajos y Servicios Remotos)
data.taxBenefit: 100% exemption from Costa Rican personal income tax on foreign-sourced income and duty-free import of computer and telecommunications equipment.
requirements: Proof of a minimum monthly income of $3,000 USD for individuals or $4,000 USD for families for the past 12 months.
Valid health insurance policy covering medical expenses for the duration of stay in Costa Rica.
Proof of remote work, freelancing, or foreign business ownership operating outside Costa Rica.

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is untaxed during the first 183 days of stay; full tax residency applies after 183 days.
requirements: Proof of remote work status with an employer or clients located outside Brazil
Minimum monthly income of USD 1,500 or proof of USD 18,000 in bank funds
Valid health insurance policy covering the entire stay in Brazil
Clean criminal record certificate issued within the past 90 days

data.taxBenefit: Foreign-sourced income is exempt from local income taxation during the temporary stay period.
requirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months validity remaining
Proof of remote employment or freelance contract with non-Argentine entities
Clean criminal record background check from country of origin or residence
Curriculum Vitae (CV) or portfolio demonstrating professional experience

data.taxBenefit: Foreign income is exempt from Mauritian tax if it is not remitted to a Mauritian bank account.
requirements: Minimum monthly income of USD 1,500 from foreign sources
Proof of long-term accommodation in Mauritius
Valid travel and health insurance for the entire duration
Return or onward travel ticket

data.taxBenefit: Exempt from local personal income tax on foreign-sourced income
requirements: Valid passport with at least 6 months remaining validity
Proof of remote employment, freelancing, or business ownership outside Seychelles
Proof of sufficient financial means and bank statements
Valid health and travel insurance covering the full duration of stay

data.taxBenefit: Tax exemption on foreign-sourced income applies if staying less than 183 days in a 12-month period.
requirements: Proof of foreign employment, remote contract, or foreign business ownership
Minimum annual gross income of ZAR 1,000,000 (~ZAR 83,333 monthly)
Comprehensive health insurance coverage for the duration of stay
Clear criminal record certificate and medical clearance reports
